# Crosswalk coverage at CodeMeta 3.1

<!-- Generated by `codemeta-drift hub coverage examples/mapping-3.1.json`; edit the curated rows, not this file. -->

How CodeMeta's 3.1 crosswalks map 17 CodeMeta terms in 5 formats, read from the reviewed [mapping export](mapping-export.md). PEP 621 has no CodeMeta crosswalk, so each of its paths is added here. This page shows the pinned tag; the [web page](https://simonvanlierde.com/codemeta-drift/) also checks CodeMeta's main branch each week.

| Mark | Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ✓ | as-is | CodeMeta's crosswalk cell is the path, used unchanged |
| ✎ | corrected | the crosswalk cell is wrong, ambiguous or prose; a curated row replaces it |
| + | added | the format has the field but the crosswalk has no cell for it; a curated row adds it |
| – | no field | the format has no field for this term |

## Curated cells

### cff-1.2.0

- `author.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `person.orcid / identifiers / doi` → `authors[].orcid`. The cell lists person.orcid / identifiers / doi; a person's ORCID is orcid.
- `contributor` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `contributor.givenName` (no field): crosswalk cell `person.given-names` → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `contributor.familyName` (no field): crosswalk cell `person.family-names` → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `contributor.@id` (no field): crosswalk cell `person.orcid / identifiers / doi` → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `license` (corrected): crosswalk cell `license / license-url` → `license`. The cell lists license / license-url; license-url holds a licence URL, not an SPDX id.
- `identifier` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identifiers / person.orcid / doi` → `doi | identifiers[type=doi].value`. The cell lists identifiers / person.orcid / doi; the software DOI is doi, or the doi entry of identifiers.
- `swhid` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identifiers / person.orcid / doi` → `identifiers[type=swh].value`. The cell lists identifiers / person.orcid / doi; a SWHID is the swh entry of identifiers.

### zenodo

- `author.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `creators[].name`. No cell; Zenodo keeps one name string per creator, written 'Family, Given'.
- `author.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `creators[].name`. No cell; Zenodo keeps one name string per creator, written 'Family, Given'.
- `author.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `ORCID` → `creators[].orcid`. The cell says ORCID; the .zenodo.json key is orcid.
- `contributor` (added): no crosswalk cell → `contributors[]`. No cell; .zenodo.json lists contributors under contributors, each with a name, a type and an optional orcid.
- `contributor.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `contributors[].name`. No cell; Zenodo keeps one name string per contributor, written 'Family, Given'.
- `contributor.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `contributors[].name`. No cell; Zenodo keeps one name string per contributor, written 'Family, Given'.
- `contributor.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `ORCID` → `contributors[].orcid`. The cell says ORCID; the .zenodo.json key is orcid.
- `identifier` (corrected): crosswalk cell `id` → `doi`. The cell says id, the Zenodo record id; the DOI field is doi.
- `swhid` (corrected): crosswalk cell `id` → `related_identifiers[scheme=swh].identifier`. The cell says id, the Zenodo record id; a SWHID is the identifier of the related_identifiers entry with scheme swh.
- `codeRepository` (corrected): crosswalk cell `related_identifiers.isSupplementTo` → `related_identifiers[relation=isSupplementTo].identifier`. The cell says related_identifiers.isSupplementTo, a relation, not a key; the URL is the identifier of the entry with that relation.
